name: diffshub-for-github
description: Browser extension that adds a fast, virtualized diff viewer to GitHub pull requests, built on Pierre's @pierre/diffs components.
author: Jan Nicklas

scripts.dev:firefox: node scripts/free-firefox.mjs && echo '' && echo '  Firefox has no dev server: it refuses to run an extension page from one.' && echo '  Every change is rebuilt and the add-on reloads. Reload the page to see it.' && echo '' && wxt build -b firefox && touch .output/.reload-stamp && concurrently -n build,firefox -c blue,magenta "nodemon -q -C -w src -w wxt.config.ts -e ts,tsx,css,html,json -x 'wxt build -b firefox && touch .output/.reload-stamp'" "web-ext run --source-dir .output/firefox-mv3"
scripts.format: oxfmt src test scripts wxt.config.ts web-ext-config.mjs
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check src test scripts wxt.config.ts web-ext-config.mjs
scripts.test:units: node test/reconstruct-old-file.mjs && node test/pull-request-paths.mjs && node test/whitespace.mjs && node test/recording-credentials.mjs && node test/response-cache.mjs && node test/pack-round-trip.mjs && node test/backpressure.mjs
